references.title: Hyndman & Athanasopoulos — Forecasting: Principles and Practice (open textbook)

title: Pharmaceutical Sales Forecasting Agent
short: Forecasts sales by product, region and channel, explains the drivers, and updates targets as new data arrives.
symptom: Sales forecasts are guesses in a spreadsheet
ingredient: A forecasting analyst for commercial teams
directions: Connect monthly sales, stock at distributors and planned activities. Get forecasts with ranges, driver explanations and territory gaps.
problem: Forecasts are often built top-down from last year plus a percentage, ignoring seasonality, distributor stock, tenders, launches and shortages.
why: Bad forecasts drive both stock-outs and expiries, misaligned production and unfair territory targets.
solution: Builds statistical and machine-learning forecasts per product and territory with seasonality and known events, separates real demand from distributor stock movements, and explains in plain language what drives each forecast.
data: Historical sales by product, region and channel
limitations: Unexpected events (shortages, policy changes) break historical patterns
Forecast ranges must be communicated, not just single numbers
review: Sales, marketing and supply planning agree the final consensus forecast.
